description:
Lists the create_checkout_link sessions made under your OAuth client, newest first: each with its status (awaiting_checkout, checkout_started, paid, label_ready, delivered, refunded or cancelled), amount, service, the item and ZIP codes you sent, the order_id once a checkout exists and the tracking number once the label does. Use it to find a session_id you no longer hold, or as a list of past labels; for one session you know, call get_checkout_status. SMKlog records only: no carrier call, no quote allowance.

Parameter rules:
- Needs a bearer token on the MCP connection (Authorization: Bearer, from /oauth/token; register a client at /oauth/register). Without one it answers token_required.
- Only sessions created while that token was sent are listed.
- limit is 1 to 50, default 20; pass next_cursor as cursor for the next page, null means the end.
- Sessions live 30 days; expired ones are not listed.
- No names, street addresses or emails.
- 60 calls an hour per client, shared with get_checkout_status.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page; omit for the newest sessions.

name: list_checkout_sessions

outputSchema.description: One page of the sessions this OAuth client created, newest first.

amount.description: USD the session was anchored to

order_id.description: SMKlog order id once a checkout exists

product.description: The item as you described it

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page; null at the end

title: List your checkout sessions
